Requirement Scrap and hand tools.

Check Crafting against a DC set by the GM

Rebuild a scrap gun into a different scrap gun of the same category — a pistol into a carbine, a carbine into a scattergun. On a success the conversion holds until you convert it again; on a critical failure the weapon is destroyed and you keep the scrap. A Good Gun cannot be converted, and a converted weapon never becomes one.
